text: @dsh-cbw/bilibili 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 B 站插件，通过注册工具、设置页和后台值班流程接入。它支持搜索视频、读取字幕与热门评论、查看用户公开收藏并分析兴趣画像，也能在设置中扫码登录和管理值班选项。适合希望在 DSH 中检索和整理 B 站内容、配置周期性视频筛选的用户。使用需登录 Bilibili；不要求单独的 API key。

@dsh-cbw/bilibili adds Bilibili tools, a settings page, and scheduled review to DSH Web. Search videos, retrieve subtitles and popular comments, inspect public favorites, and create interest profiles. QR login connects a Bilibili account; no separate API key is needed.
想在 DSH 里按关键词搜索 B 站视频，并读取字幕和热门评论。
我想让 DSH 根据公开收藏内容整理一个用户的兴趣画像。
I want DSH to review Bilibili videos on a schedule and show the controls in its settings page.
@dsh-cbw/bilibili 的功能「视频搜索与内容查看」：在 DSH 工具中按关键词搜索 B 站视频，并可获取视频字幕和热门评论。
@dsh-cbw/bilibili 的功能「收藏兴趣画像」：工具读取用户公开收藏夹中的视频并生成兴趣画像，可选择写入配套 memory 插件。
@dsh-cbw/bilibili 使用前须知：视频检索和用户资料功能会请求 Bilibili 服务；扫码登录后，私信读取也访问 Bilibili API。（见 index.js:3324、lib/dm.mjs:28-47）

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · @dsh-cbw/bilibili：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that watches Bilibili for you — searches, reads subtitles, picks worth-your-time videos, writes a daily report, and @-mentions you. Forked from [`dsh-bili-scroll`](https://github.com/c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll) v2.3.1 with significant enhancements: auto session management (duty rounds + DM replies share one session, auto create/reuse/rebuild/attach-to-workspace), master profile analysis, hobby画像, interest learning with half-life decay, storyboard frames, and comment safety gates.

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Inherited from upstream (dsh-bili-scroll v2.3.1)：- **Duty rounds** — peak/valley scheduling, searches Bilibili, reads subtitles, writes daily report
- **13 host tools** — `bili_whoami`, `bili_search`, `bili_subtitle`, `bili_comments`, `bili_cover`, `bili_frames`, `bili_reply`, `bili_status`, `bili_run`, `bili_login_start/poll`, `bili_setup`, `bili_config`
- **MCP duty-round tools** — search/recommend, subtitle/comments/danmaku, cover/frames, reply/send_message, transcribe
- **DM watch** — listens for master's private messages, replies with session continuity
- **Auto-favorite** — host-side `favops.py`
- **Configurable model** — `modelProvider`/`modelName` per duty round
- **Timeout watchdog** — `runTimeoutMinutes` (default 20)

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Added in this fork：- **Auto session management** — duty rounds and DM replies **share one DSH session**, preserving full conversation context across rounds. First run auto-creates a session (no preset, reusable by one-shot runner), captures sessionId into config, then reuses it; on session invalidation (does not exist / does not compose) auto-clears ID and rebuilds. Optionally attaches to a chosen workspace (sidebar grouping, shared pet memory).
- **Master profile & hobby analysis** — `masterUid` identifies the master; `bili_analyze_hobby` analyzes public favorites + following list → hobby画像 → injected into @dsh-cbw/memory as long-term facts. Configurable refresh cycle (`hobbyRefreshDays`, default 30).
- **Decoupled identity** — `masterUid` (master, by UID) vs `mentionNames` (comment @-list, by nickname, multiple) vs `dmRecipients` (DM recipients, multiple). Friends can be added to share recommendations without being the master.
- **Interest learning with half-life decay** — replaces static `keywords` config; auto-extracts interest words from picked videos, decays over time. *[Borrowed from bilihave/dsh-whale-panel]*
- **Storyboard frames** — multi-grid拼接

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Derived From：This plugin is **directly forked** from [`c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll`](https://github.com/c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll) v2.3.1 (MIT License). The upstream `upstream` git remote is preserved for syncing future upstream updates:

```bash
git fetch upstream
git merge upstream/main
```

All upstream code (`index.js`, `client.js`, `lib/`, `prompts/`, `vendor/`, `profile-template/`) is inherited; modifications are layered on top.

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Required (for added features)：- **[@dsh-cbw/memory](https://github.com/Scorpioflz/dsh-cbw-memory)** — hobby画像 and interest words are stored as long-term facts. Optional but recommended; without it,画像 is only kept locally in `hobby.json`.

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Differences from Upstream：| Area | Upstream (dsh-bili-scroll) | This fork (@dsh-cbw/bilibili) |
|---|---|---|
| Duty session | One-shot CLI spawn per round, no context | Auto session management: first run creates a no-preset session → captures sessionId → reuses thereafter; duty rounds + DM replies share one session; auto-rebuilds on invalidation; can attach to a workspace |
| Master identity | `mentionName` (nickname, single) + `dmUid` | `masterUid` (UID) + `mentionNames[]` (nicknames) + `dmRecipientUids[]` (UIDs) |
| Hobby analysis | None | `bili_user_favorites` / `bili_user_profile` / `bili_analyze_hobby` |
| Search keywords | Static `keywords[]` config | Auto-learned interest words with half-life decay |
| Frames | Single frame `bili_frames` | Storyboard multi-grid拼接 `bili_storyboard` |
| Comment gate | Tone gate + autoComment gate | + three-layer hard block (politics/government/frontier) |
| Report | Full/brief/off | + watch statistics (completion/time distribution/late-night ratio) + inbox classification (replies/@/likes) |
@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Installation：```bash
@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Recommended (npm)：dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-cbw/bilibili
@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · From GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:Scorpioflz/dsh-cbw-bilibili

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · From local path：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cbw-bilibili
```

> **Prerequisite**: Python 3.10+ or `uv` on the machine. The plugin auto-downloads `uv` if neither is present.
> **After install**: restart DSH (bundle layer needs restart), then go to Settings → 刷B站 → install dependencies → scan-login.
> **Recommended companion**: install `@dsh-cbw/memory` (for画像 persistence).
@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Configuration：All settings are configurable via the DSH settings page or `~/.dsh/dsh-cbw-bilibili/config.json`.

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Identity (new in this fork)：| Parameter | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `masterUid` | `0` | Master's Bilibili UID. Used for hobby analysis target, DM watch whitelist |
| `mentionNames` | `[]` | Comment @-list (nicknames, multiple). Friends can be included |
| `dmRecipientUids` | `[]` | DM recipients UIDs (string array, multiple) |

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Auto session management (new in this fork)：| Parameter | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `workspace` | `''` | Workspace path for the duty session. Settings page shows a dropdown of all registered workspaces; choose "no workspace" to keep session in the plugin home dir. Set to pet workspace path to share memory |
| `sessionId` | `''` | Current reused session ID (auto-managed internally, no need to fill). Empty on first run → auto-created → captured & stored; auto-cleared & rebuilt on invalidation |
| `webapiBase` | `''` | dsh-web-service base URL (for P1 hobby analysis API; empty = auto-detect `127.0.0.1:3080`) |
| `webapiKey` | `''` | API Key (empty = local no-auth) |

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · @dsh-cbw/bilibili：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that watches Bilibili for you — searches, reads subtitles, picks worth-your-time videos, writes a daily report, and @-mentions you. Forked from [`dsh-bili-scroll`](https://github.com/c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll) v2.3.1 with significant enhancements: auto session management (duty rounds + DM replies share one session, auto create/reuse/rebuild/attach-to-workspace), master profile analysis, hobby画像, interest learning with half-life decay, storyboard frames, and comment safety gates.

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Inherited from upstream (dsh-bili-scroll v2.3.1)：- **Duty rounds** — peak/valley scheduling, searches Bilibili, reads subtitles, writes daily report
- **13 host tools** — `bili_whoami`, `bili_search`, `bili_subtitle`, `bili_comments`, `bili_cover`, `bili_frames`, `bili_reply`, `bili_status`, `bili_run`, `bili_login_start/poll`, `bili_setup`, `bili_config`
- **MCP duty-round tools** — search/recommend, subtitle/comments/danmaku, cover/frames, reply/send_message, transcribe
- **DM watch** — listens for master's private messages, replies with session continuity
- **Auto-favorite** — host-side `favops.py`
- **Configurable model** — `modelProvider`/`modelName` per duty round
- **Timeout watchdog** — `runTimeoutMinutes` (default 20)

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Added in this fork：- **Auto session management** — duty rounds and DM replies **share one DSH session**, preserving full conversation context across rounds. First run auto-creates a session (no preset, reusable by one-shot runner), captures sessionId into config, then reuses it; on session invalidation (does not exist / does not compose) auto-clears ID and rebuilds. Optionally attaches to a chosen workspace (sidebar grouping, shared pet memory).
- **Master profile & hobby analysis** — `masterUid` identifies the master; `bili_analyze_hobby` analyzes public favorites + following list → hobby画像 → injected into @dsh-cbw/memory as long-term facts. Configurable refresh cycle (`hobbyRefreshDays`, default 30).
- **Decoupled identity** — `masterUid` (master, by UID) vs `mentionNames` (comment @-list, by nickname, multiple) vs `dmRecipients` (DM recipients, multiple). Friends can be added to share recommendations without being the master.
- **Interest learning with half-life decay** — replaces static `keywords` config; auto-extracts interest words from picked videos, decays over time. *[Borrowed from bilihave/dsh-whale-panel]*
- **Storyboard frames** — multi-grid拼接

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Differences from Upstream：| Area | Upstream (dsh-bili-scroll) | This fork (@dsh-cbw/bilibili) |
|---|---|---|
| Duty session | One-shot CLI spawn per round, no context | Auto session management: first run creates a no-preset session → captures sessionId → reuses thereafter; duty rounds + DM replies share one session; auto-rebuilds on invalidation; can attach to a workspace |
| Master identity | `mentionName` (nickname, single) + `dmUid` | `masterUid` (UID) + `mentionNames[]` (nicknames) + `dmRecipientUids[]` (UIDs) |
| Hobby analysis | None | `bili_user_favorites` / `bili_user_profile` / `bili_analyze_hobby` |
| Search keywords | Static `keywords[]` config | Auto-learned interest words with half-life decay |
| Frames | Single frame `bili_frames` | Storyboard multi-grid拼接 `bili_storyboard` |
| Comment gate | Tone gate + autoComment gate | + three-layer hard block (politics/government/frontier) |
| Report | Full/brief/off | + watch statistics (completion/time distribution/late-night ratio) + inbox classification (replies/@/likes) |
@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Installation：```bash
@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Recommended (npm)：dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-cbw/bilibili
@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · From GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:Scorpioflz/dsh-cbw-bilibili

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · From local path：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cbw-bilibili
```

> **Prerequisite**: Python 3.10+ or `uv` on the machine. The plugin auto-downloads `uv` if neither is present.
> **After install**: restart DSH (bundle layer needs restart), then go to Settings → 刷B站 → install dependencies → scan-login.
> **Recommended companion**: install `@dsh-cbw/memory` (for画像 persistence).
@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Configuration：All settings are configurable via the DSH settings page or `~/.dsh/dsh-cbw-bilibili/config.json`.

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Identity (new in this fork)：| Parameter | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `masterUid` | `0` | Master's Bilibili UID. Used for hobby analysis target, DM watch whitelist |
| `mentionNames` | `[]` | Comment @-list (nicknames, multiple). Friends can be included |
| `dmRecipientUids` | `[]` | DM recipients UIDs (string array, multiple) |

@dsh-cbw/bilibili README · Auto session management (new in this fork)：| Parameter | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `workspace` | `''` | Workspace path for the duty session. Settings page shows a dropdown of all registered workspaces; choose "no workspace" to keep session in the plugin home dir. Set to pet workspace path to share memory |
| `sessionId` | `''` | Current reused session ID (auto-managed internally, no need to fill). Empty on first run → auto-created → captured & stored; auto-cleared & rebuilt on invalidation |
| `webapiBase` | `''` | dsh-web-service base URL (for P1 hobby analysis API; empty = auto-detect `127.0.0.1:3080`) |
| `webapiKey` | `''` | API Key (empty = local no-auth) |
